rows.quote: a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor
rows.reason_zh: 按一次施放可伤害多个敌人的定义，多只甲虫分头附着攻击已与原 reject 有冲突，但两版对此描述相同，无法归为 7.42 导致的判定变化。

rows.quote: attacking and reducing armor until it is killed
rows.reason_zh: 甲虫附着后仍会攻击目标并降低其护甲。

rows.quote: Beetles are Spell Immune
rows.reason_zh: 技能免疫仍作用于甲虫本体。

rows.quote: Beetles provide vision.
rows.reason_zh: 甲虫仍提供视野。

new_mechanisms.quote: Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to beetles.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42 明确将小兵和幻象对甲虫造成的伤害降至 25%，属于仅针对这两类来源的比例减伤。

rows.quote: While the thread holds, the enemy is slowed again every %established_thread_duration%s. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.
rows.reason_zh: 连线对该敌人重复施加减速，并给编织者增加攻击伤害，说明中没有一次对多个敌人造成伤害的效果。

rows.quote: thread_setup_time: 1.5→1.25
rows.reason_zh: 所给字段只说明建立连线所需时间缩短，未给出可用于核实原 accept 的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: While the thread holds, the enemy is slowed again every %established_thread_duration%s.
rows.reason_zh: 建立连线时的减速仍在，7.42 还会在线维持期间定期再次减速。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍对编织者自身施加强驱散。

rows.quote: No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.
rows.reason_zh: 时光倒流不会改变金钱或经验。

rows.quote: regaining the HP and mana from that time
rows.reason_zh: 五秒前的生命值较高时，回溯仍能为编织者恢复生命。

rows.quote: regaining the HP and mana from that time
rows.reason_zh: 五秒前的法力值较高时，回溯仍能为编织者恢复法力。

rows.quote: Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.
rows.reason_zh: 施放时光倒流仍能躲避已飞来的弹道。

rows.quote: Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍能使编织者回到自己五秒前的位置。

rows.quote: Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone
rows.reason_zh: 每次施放只卷起一个目标，敌方目标落地时受到伤害，说明未列出波及周围单位的效果。

rows.quote: Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 吹风仍施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 目标仍会被卷起，并在吹风期间无敌。

rows.quote: Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 装备主动效果仍能将所选单位短暂吹起。

rows.quote: bonus_movement_speed: 30→25
rows.reason_zh: 装备移速加成降至 25，仍能提高持有者的移动速度。

rows.quote: making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 被卷起的目标在吹风期间仍处于无敌状态。

rows.quote: bonus_movement_speed: 30→25
rows.reason_zh: 材料只给出装备移速的数值变化，主动说明和字段均未给出回蓝效果或回蓝数值。

rows.quote: When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of %tornado_speed%.
rows.reason_zh: 对自己施放时仍可主动移动旋风，改变自身位置。

rows.quote: When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
rows.reason_zh: 对自己施放时旋风可移至任意位置，支持吹风期间无视地形移动。

rows.quote: with a reduction to her attack damage and her Item Potency
rows.reason_zh: 攻击伤害和物品效力的降低都作用于风行者自身，敌方目标的攻击力没有受到削减。

rows.quote: against a single enemy unit or structure
rows.reason_zh: 基础施放方式仍可选择单个敌方单位，随机射击属于另列的命石效果。

rows.quote: Break disables the gaining of new stacks. Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
rows.reason_zh: 7.42 新增说明明确破坏会阻止获得新层数，已有层数的加成仍生效，已符合技能部分可被破坏的定义。

rows.quote: gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能触发顺风时仍会短暂提高风行者的移速。

rows.quote: allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack
rows.reason_zh: 烧灼逐次附在普通攻击上，说明未写单次攻击会波及其他敌人。

rows.quote: slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of %percent_damage%%% of their current health each second
rows.reason_zh: 普通攻击仍附带减速和按目标当前生命值计算的持续伤害。

rows.quote: Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.
rows.reason_zh: A 杖升级仍会提升寒冬飞龙自身的移动速度。

rows.quote: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active.
rows.reason_zh: A 杖开启技能后每秒消耗施法者自己的法力，说明未写削减敌方法力。

rows.quote: draining mana every second when active
rows.reason_zh: A 杖开启技能会持续消耗自身法力，没有为自身恢复法力的效果。

rows.quote: slow enemies with a magical freeze
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能强化的攻击仍会减慢敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: granting her unobstructed movement
rows.reason_zh: 寒冬飞龙在基础技能的飞行期间仍可无视地形移动。

rows.quote: The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
rows.reason_zh: 冰茧仍会为目标挡下全部物理伤害。
每秒固定治疗量调整后各级仍为正值，按目标最大生命值计算的治疗也仍保留。

rows.quote: hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a %split_radius% base radius
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放产生的碎片仍能伤害主目标周围的多个敌人。

rows.quote: Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by %movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 被碎片击中的敌人仍会减速。

rows.quote: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit.
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍选择一个单位作为主弹道目标，即使该目标本身不受碎片伤害也符合单位指向。

rows.quote: health regeneration based on max health
rows.reason_zh: 过载持续时间由 8 秒缩短至 7 秒，期间仍按最大生命值提供生命恢复。

rows.quote: Overcharge grants attack speed and spell amplification to Io and any Tethered allies.
rows.reason_zh: 提供法术放大的过载效果仍对艾欧及其连接的友军生效。

rows.quote: Causes your next attack to apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 持有者的下一次攻击仍能施毒，7.42 新增说明仅排除了幻象触发。

rows.quote: Illusions do not apply Witch Blade
rows.reason_zh: 新增说明只涉及幻象能否触发被动，材料未提供可核实装备回蓝的说明或属性值。

rows.quote: This attack has True Strike.
rows.reason_zh: 触发巫师之刃的攻击仍具有必中效果。

rows.quote: slowing by %slow%%%
rows.reason_zh: 持有者施加的毒素仍会减速目标。

rows.quote: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
rows.reason_zh: A 杖仍让守卫的攻击在附近敌人之间弹射，一次攻击可伤害多个目标。

rows.quote: only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires
rows.reason_zh: 打断指巫医自身的引导可被中止，说明没有赋予守卫打断敌方持续施法的效果。

rows.quote: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range.
rows.reason_zh: 死亡守卫仍需要巫医持续引导。

rows.quote: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
rows.reason_zh: 两版都明确守卫本体无敌，原 reject 若指守卫则早已与说明冲突，若指施法者则成立，该行未注明作用对象。

rows.quote: Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只给出额外命中率的占位符，缺少实际数值，无法确认攻击必定无视闪避。

rows.quote: Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range.
rows.reason_zh: 技能生成的是死亡守卫，按给定的召唤物定义应予排除。

rows.quote: movement_speed_percent_bonus: 12→10
rows.reason_zh: 移速加成由 12% 降至 10%，装备仍能加速。

rows.quote: mana_regen_multiplier: 30→25
rows.reason_zh: 回蓝倍率加成降至 25%，仍会提高自身法力恢复。

rows.quote: spell_amp: 12→10
rows.reason_zh: 法术放大由 12% 降至 10%，效果仍在。

rows.quote: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
rows.reason_zh: 该金钱是敌方英雄摧毁雷云所得的赏金，按定义不计为额外经济。

rows.quote: Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
rows.reason_zh: 材料只说明雷云会施放当前等级的雷击，未给出雷击的眩晕说明或相应的 A 杖条件。

rows.quote: his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage
rows.reason_zh: 说明确认攻击会产生弧形闪电，但未写明一次触发能命中多少个敌人。

rows.quote: his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage
rows.reason_zh: 两版都明确写有攻击特效，但所给说明和字段均未交代获得该效果是否需要魔晶。

rows.quote: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage.
rows.reason_zh: 技能主说明仍写明宙斯本人的普通攻击会触发弧形闪电，删除的是幻象伤害比例字段。

rows.quote: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit with his abilities
rows.reason_zh: 静电场逐个对受到攻击或技能命中的敌人触发，说明未写该次电击会波及其他单位。

rows.quote: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit with his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
rows.reason_zh: 宙斯的普通攻击仍会附加按目标当前生命值计算的电击伤害。

rows.quote: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit with his abilities
rows.reason_zh: 说明只交代电击的触发方式，材料未提供可核实破坏交互的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放仍能伤害所有敌方英雄，命石令伤害依次结算也符合多目标伤害定义。

rows.quote: Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
rows.reason_zh: 雷击落下前仍会在每名敌方英雄周围提供真视。
